wikipedia-20537000.evidence: Activision’s1June2010 release assigns the original score to Lorne Balfe; Hans Zimmer is credited for the main theme and executive music production.
wikipedia-20537000.verification: Primary publisher, creator or original label-delivery evidence; roles and scope retained
wikipedia-20537000.track_scope: Do not assign Zimmer as composer of every cue. Credit individual tracks from their actual label delivery; a game-level Zimmer/Balfe roster is not proof that each track is co-composed.

workbook-02-20-the-order-1886.verification: Primary publisher, creator or original label-delivery evidence; roles and scope retained
workbook-02-20-the-order-1886.warning: A label’s repeated album-wide composer list must not override these explicit composer/publisher roles.

wikipedia-52464953.evidence: Naughty Dog’s official2020 announcement identifies the original PartII soundtrack as the work of Gustavo Santaolalla and Mac Quayle.
wikipedia-52464953.verification: Primary publisher, creator or original label-delivery evidence; roles and scope retained
wikipedia-52464953.track_scope: Game-level roster; preserve individual Sony/Mondo recording credits. Do not assume the two wrote each cue jointly.

wikipedia-28344576.verification: Primary publisher, creator or original label-delivery evidence; roles and scope retained

roles.Jim Bonney: Music director; some original compositions and arrangements

wikipedia-28344576.track_scope: Bonney’s own words establish contribution, not universal co-composition. Admit Bonney for individually credited cues only; separately identify arrangements of licensed songs and later Burial at Sea DLC.

wikipedia-66086932.evidence: UMG’s original label delivery for Alpha explicitly assigns composer roles to all four named people. Finishing Move Inc. is the credited collective artist/producer.

wikipedia-66086932.track_scope: Alpha is directly verified. Expand to other tracks only when the original UMG delivery gives its own composer roster; do not infer every group member composed every recording.

wikipedia-355914.evidence: Nintendo’s original English staff credits spell its music-composition staff member Minako Hamano, corroborating the canonical spelling independently of an uploader’s typo.
wikipedia-355914.verification: Primary canonical-name spelling only; Super Metroid game attribution remains separately required
wikipedia-355914.track_scope: Correct an uploader’s misspelling only after the recording is independently verified as original Super Metroid music. The source is not evidence that Brain Training music belongs to Super Metroid.

wikipedia-2949575.title: Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon and the Blade of Light
wikipedia-2949575.finding: Do not add Tanaka as co-composer automatically.
